profileEvidence.summary: Working cattle on Welsh hill farms, this old sheepdog type persisted locally into the 1980s. Barbara Carpenter reported seeing remnants bred within one district, even as Border Collies replaced older British herding types. A c.1898 photograph identified by historian David Hancock places one beside a Welsh drover.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An old Welsh herding type remembered in hill-farm cattle work and droving, with remnants documented in the 1980s.
